name: Question 7
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration $a(t)=3\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t),$ where $t\ge 0$ is the time. If the particle has position $x=5$ and velocity $v=1$ when $t=0,$ calculate the position $x$ of the particle at time $t.$
worked_solution:
We start by integrating the acceleration to get the velocity $v(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}v(t) & =\int a(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int 3\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)\text{d}t \\  & =-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+C\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $C,$ we use the fact that $v(0)=1.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}1 & =-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3(0))+C \\ 1 & =-1+C \\ C & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

So the velocity is given by $v(t)=2-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t).$

Now, we integrate the velocity to get $x(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & =\int v(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int (2-\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t))\text{d}t \\  & =2t-\frac{1}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)+K\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $K,$ we use the fact that $x(0)=5.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}5 & =2(0)-\frac{1}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3(0))+K \\ K & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the position $x$ of the particle at time $t$ is 

$$
x(t)=2t-\frac{1}{3}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)+5.
$$

Question 7
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration a(t)=3sin⁡(3t), where t≥0 is the time. If the particle has position x=5 and velocity v=1 when t=0, calculate the position x of the particle at time t.

a
x(t)=t+13sin⁡(3t)+5
b
x(t)=2t−13sin⁡(3t)+5
c
x(t)=2t−3cos⁡(3t)+8
d
x(t)=cos⁡(3t)+4
e
x(t)=2t+3sin⁡(3t)+5
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We start by integrating the acceleration to get the velocity v(t):

v(t)=∫a(t)dt=∫3sin⁡(3t)dt=−cos⁡(3t)+C

To determine C, we use the fact that v(0)=1. Substituting this into the above gives

1=−cos⁡(3(0))+C1=−1+CC=2.

So the velocity is given by v(t)=2−cos⁡(3t).

Now, we integrate the velocity to get x(t):

x(t)=∫v(t)dt=∫(2−cos⁡(3t))dt=2t−13sin⁡(3t)+K

To determine K, we use the fact that x(0)=5. Substituting this into the above gives

5=2(0)−13sin⁡(3(0))+KK=5.

Therefore, the position x of the particle at time t is x(t)=2t−13sin⁡(3t)+5.
